Repro (develop + fz-sc8.151, binary /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/k127d/fz2-base): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/k127d/keep/anypure8.fz — eight Enum.reduce calls over one value typed any, each with its own accumulator type and a reducer that ignores its arguments (generated by /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/k127/gen.py, pure variant, k = 8).

interp compiles and runs. run fails before running anything:
    fz2 run: compiler2 root 0 JIT compile failed: codegen: verify reduce__e268:
    - inst28 (jump block4(v15, v17, v37, v2)): uses value v37 from non-dominating inst26
Full output: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/k127d/keep/run8.out. The accumulator-reading variant at k = 8 fails the same way. k = 1, 2, 4 run correctly (anypure4.fz beside it).

Not investigated: which reduce function is reduce__e268 and which branch defines v37. Same verifier class as fz-sc8.46 (a guard shape); no evidence yet that the cause is shared.

Done when: an oracle fixture of this program agrees with Elixir on interp, run and build.
title: Eight Enum.reduce sites over one any value compile in the JIT
